summary: Murder of three persons under IPC s.302/149; eyewitness testimony upheld; conviction affirmed; life sentence without remission imposed by trial court; jurisdictional error in modified sentence by trial court; High Court's power to impose fixed-term sentence affirmed per Sriharan; gravity of brutal group attack considered; sentence modified to 30 years rigorous imprisonment without remission.
legal_provisions_cited: Union of India v. V. Sriharan alias Murugan & Ors.
Shiva Kumar alias Shiva alias Shivamurthy v. State of Karnataka
Swamy Shraddananda (2) alias Murali Manohar Mishra v. State of Karnataka
final_judgment: Appeal partly allowed; conviction upheld; sentence modified to 30 years rigorous imprisonment without remission; life term set aside.
